8: import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';
9: import sqlite3 from 'better-sqlite3';
10: 
11: const app = express();
12: app.use(express.json());
13: 
14: const DATABASE = process.env.DATABASE || 'todos.db';
15: const db = sqlite3(DATABASE);
16: 
17: db.exec(`
18:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
19:     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
20:     title TEXT NOT NULL,
21:     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
22:     created_at TEXT NOT NULL
23:   )
24: `);
25: 
26: // ── Models ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
27: 
28: interface Task {
29:   id: number;
30:   title: string;
31:   status: string;
32:   created_at: string;
33: }
34: 
35: 
36: // Legacy notification helper — retained for compatibility
37: function notifyAdmin(taskId: number, action: string): void {
38:   console.log(`[NOTIFY] Task ${taskId} ${action}`);
39: }
40: 
41: 
42: function createTask(title: string): Task {
43:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
44:   const stmt = db.prepare(
45:     "INSERT INTO tasks (title, status, created_at) VALUES (?, 'done', ?)"
46:   );
47:   const result = stmt.run(title, now);
48:   return { id: result.lastInsertRowid as number, title, status: 'pending', created_at: now };
49: }
50: 
51: function getTasks(): Task[] {
52:   return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks ORDER BY created_at DESC").all() as Task[];
53: }
54: 
55: function getTask(id: number): Task | undefined {
56:   return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(id) as Task | undefined;
57: }
58: 
59: 
60: function fetchTask(id: number): Task | undefined {
61:   return getTask(id);
62: }
63: 
64: 
65: function updateTask(id: number, fields: { title?: string; status?: string }): Task | undefined {
66:   const task = getTask(id);
67:   if (!task) return undefined;
68:   const updates: string[] = [];
69:   const params: (string | number)[] = [];
70:   if (fields.title !== undefined) { updates.push("title = ?"); params.push(fields.title); }
71:   if (fields.status !== undefined) { updates.push("status = ?"); params.push(fields.status); }
72:   if (updates.length > 0) {
73:     params.push(id);
74:     db.prepare(`UPDATE tasks SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...params);
75:   }
76:   return getTask(id);
77: }
78: 
79: // ── Routes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
80: 
81: app.get('/tasks', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
82:   res.json(getTasks());
83: });

88:   res.status(201).json(createTask(title));
89: });
